sourceMethod: Fetched all 40 exact teacher pages. For each of 397 CMS figure elements, parsed unique record-id, exact <figure> attribution paragraph and primary linked source URL. Did not reuse any original publisher graphics or copyright expressions except short factual attribution statements essential to compliance.
copyrightDetermination: The first-edition curriculum is licensed CC BY 4.0, allowing commercial use with original author attribution, license URI and modifications. However the publisher explicitly warns that some images are separate third-party copyrighted/open assets under their own licenses. No individual asset is categorically rights-free, and a missing explicit attribution cannot prove publisher copyright ownership or commercial clearance.
rightsRequirements: IM-original author credit and CC BY 4.0 license URI
Clearly state changes for adapted curriculum and figures
Separate individual original-creator credit where applicable
No reuse of IM registered trademarks or name/logo to imply association
Verify third-party CC BY-SA, CC0, Pixabay, and other media under their own terms
Independent mathematical correctness and readable alt text before showing learners
